changes.newText: The magnifier button opens the search palette, which lets you jump to any page, page tab, or setting item without leaving the keyboard.
changes.newHtml:
The magnifier button opens the search palette, which lets you jump to any page,
page tab, or setting item without leaving the keyboard.

changes.newText: The search palette is an experimental feature and is turned off by default. The Search button appears in the top bar, and its shortcut works, only while the Command palette item under Experimental features on the User Settings page is enabled.
changes.newHtml: The search palette is an experimental feature and is turned off by default. The Search button appears in the top bar, and its shortcut works, only while the Command palette item under Experimental features on the User Settings page is enabled.

changes.newText: Click the button, or press Ctrl-K (Cmd-K on macOS), to open the palette. The shortcut works even while the cursor is in an input field.
changes.newHtml: Click the button, or press Ctrl-K (Cmd-K on macOS), to open the palette. The shortcut works even while the cursor is in an input field.

changes.newText: Type in the search field, whose placeholder reads Search pages, tabs, and settings, to look up pages, page tabs, and setting items at once. A result that matched the description of an item rather than its name shows a Found in ... line naming where the word was found, and a result that belongs to the administration menus carries an Administration or Project administration tag. When nothing matches what you typed, No results is shown.
changes.newHtml: Type in the search field, whose placeholder reads Search pages, tabs, and settings, to look up pages, page tabs, and setting items at once. A result that matched the description of an item rather than its name shows a Found in ... line naming where the word was found, and a result that belongs to the administration menus carries an Administration or Project administration tag. changes.newText: The palette also offers quick actions in three groups.
changes.newHtml: The palette also offers quick actions in three groups.

changes.newText: Create: Start a new session, create a storage folder, or create a deployment.
changes.newHtml: Create: Start a new session, create a storage folder, or create a deployment.

changes.newText: Appearance: Switch to dark or light mode, use the system theme, or change the UI language.
changes.newHtml: Appearance: Switch to dark or light mode, use the system theme, or change the UI language.

changes.newText: Panels & help: Open user settings, open notifications, toggle the sidebar, or open the manual for the current page.
changes.newHtml: Panels & help: Open user settings, open notifications, toggle the sidebar, or open the manual for the current page.

changes.newText: Before you type anything, the results you opened most recently are listed at the top under Recent.
changes.newHtml: Before you type anything, the results you opened most recently are listed at the top under Recent.
